editorial.summary: Nadav Itzkowitz interviews Yoshi Obayashi about DVDASA Episode 10, friendship/employment conflict, estrangement, later mental-health reinterpretation, suicide loss, paid clinical studies and current-at-recording work. David Choe is absent. The 225-decision correction layer repairs names, titles and terms while comparing the retrospective against the audited primary: Rody researched and brought the Japanese snacks, and Episode 10 is a long ownership/trust/apology/power conflict rather than a simple firing over travel-bought chips. Yoshi’s admission, hunger context, accountability and changed interpretation all remain; diagnoses, wealth, legal, abuse, family, study and charity claims stay attributed or verification-required.
